basic_details.job_title: HLL Associate Manager Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: HLL Lifecare Limited, a Government of India enterprise under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, is filling 3 Associate Manager (Biomedical) posts in its HCD (Projects & Services – Division) on an Executive – Fixed Term Contract, with a basic pay range of Rs. 25,000 – 45,000 per month. The essential qualification is BE / B.Tech or M.Sc in the listed biomedical and electronics disciplines, or a Diploma. Applications go through a Google Form from 03.11.2026 to 18.11.2026 (Reference Code HLL/HR/107/2026).

qualification.details: BE/B.Tech/M.Sc holders: minimum 1 year of post-qualification experience. Diploma holders: minimum 7 years of post-qualification experience. For both, the experience must be in executing assigned activities at government hospitals, medical colleges and similar institutes, including surveys, technical documentation, tender support, inspections and project follow-up, in line with government procurement rules. | The notice states that the cut-off date for age is the same as the cut-off date for calculating qualification and post-qualification experience. SC/ST/OBC/PwD candidates are eligible for relaxation as per Government of India directives; the notice does not print the relaxation amounts. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility details.

how_to_apply: Open the Google Form through the HLL Associate Manager (Biomedical) Google Form.
Download the prescribed job application form from the link provided in the form or from the HLL website.
Fill in the application form digitally and save it as a PDF or Word file. Handwritten applications will not be accepted.
Upload the completed application form using the file upload option in the Google Form. The maximum upload size is 10 MB per file.
Attach additional supporting documents in PDF or Word format if required (CV, educational/experience certificates, latest salary slip), each file under 10 MB.
Select the correct post applied for in the form.
Submit the form on or before the deadline. Late submissions will not be considered.

content_sections.heading: About HLL
content_sections.text: HLL Lifecare Limited is a Government of India enterprise under the administrative control of the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare. The notice says it commenced operations on 5 April 1969 and now works across healthcare manufacturing, retail pharmacy, diagnostics, imaging services, healthcare infrastructure development, procurement consultancy, hospital management and other allied services. It gives the HLL Group's annual business turnover as approximately ₹6,500 crore.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists 3 positions for Associate Manager (Biomedical), one each at the three posting locations below.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply. The notice gives two alternative qualification routes for the post. BE/B.Tech/M.Sc holders: minimum 1 year of post-qualification experience. Diploma holders: minimum 7 years of post-qualification experience. For both, the experience must be in executing assigned activities at government hospitals, medical colleges and similar institutes, including surveys, technical documentation, tender support, inspections and project follow-up, in line with government procurement rules. The notice states that the cut-off date for age is the same as the cut-off date for calculating qualification and post-qualification experience. SC/ST/OBC/PwD candidates are eligible for relaxation as per Government of India directives; the notice does not print the relaxation amounts. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility details.

content_sections.text: The contract type is Executive – Fixed Term Contract. The length of the contract is not specified in the notice.

content_sections.heading: HLL Associate Manager (Biomedical) Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice lists these tasks for the post: Conduct site visits and gap assessments across Government Hospitals, Medical Colleges and Institutes; prepare equipment inventories and room-wise requirements. Draft generic technical specifications and layouts; verify estimated costs using GeM, past orders and market rates. Support tender preparation, pre-bid replies, technical evaluation and comparative statements. Track tenders and purchase orders on GeM, CPPP and state e-procurement portals; maintain tender records. Follow up with suppliers on delivery, contract timelines, LD, performance security/BGs, insurance and import documents. Coordinate pre-dispatch and joint inspections, installation, testing and commissioning; check supplies against the PO. Prepare inspection checklists, punch lists, acceptance and handover documents. Verify bills against contract terms and maintain asset, warranty, CAMC and billing records, including applicable deductions. Coordinate with institute departments, stores, purchase, accounts, biomedical teams and suppliers for requirements, training and issue resolution. Maintain complete, audit-ready project records; follow site safety and infection-control rules and report progress and delays regularly. Perform any other duties assigned by management.

content_sections.text: Open the Google Form through the HLL Associate Manager (Biomedical) Google Form . Download the prescribed job application form from the link provided in the form or from the HLL website. Fill in the application form digitally and save it as a PDF or Word file. Handwritten applications will not be accepted. Upload the completed application form using the file upload option in the Google Form. The maximum upload size is 10 MB per file. Attach additional supporting documents in PDF or Word format if required (CV, educational/experience certificates, latest salary slip), each file under 10 MB. Select the correct post applied for in the form. Submit the form on or before the deadline. Late submissions will not be considered. content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notice says all information submitted in the application will be verified with original documents at the time of the interview. If any information is found to be false, incorrect or not in conformity with the eligibility criteria, the candidature is liable to be rejected or cancelled at any stage of the recruitment process. The interview date, venue and mode are not specified in the notice. The decision of Management regarding selection will be final.

faq.question: Q1. How many Associate Manager (Biomedical) vacancies are there at HLL?
faq.answer: There are 3 positions, one each at Guwahati, Lucknow and Jharkhand.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for HLL Associate Manager (Biomedical)?
faq.answer: The last date is 18.11.2026. The Google Form opened on 03.11.2026, and late submissions will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for HLL Associate Manager (Biomedical)?
faq.answer: Candidates need BE / B.Tech (Biomedical / Electronics & Instrumentation / Electronics & Communication / Medical Electronics) or M.Sc (Biomedical Instrumentation), OR a Diploma in Biomedical / Electronics & Instrumentation / other equivalent qualification as per requirement.

faq.question: Q4. What experience is required?
faq.answer: BE/B.Tech/M.Sc holders need minimum 1 year of post-qualification experience, and Diploma holders need minimum 7 years, in the government hospital and medical college project activities described in the notice.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 37 years for Degree holders and 40 years for Diploma holders, as on 01.11.2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of HLL Associate Manager (Biomedical)?
faq.answer: The basic pay range is Rs. 25,000 – 45,000 per month. Gross salary is approx. Rs. 51,525.00 (Non-Metro) and annual CTC approx. 7.40 Lakhs (Non-Metro), both at the minimum of the scale.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for HLL Associate Manager (Biomedical)?
faq.answer: Open the Google Form, download the prescribed application form, fill it in digitally, and upload it as a PDF or Word file under 10 MB. Select the correct post and submit before the deadline.

faq.question: Q8. Is the HLL Associate Manager (Biomedical) job permanent?
faq.answer: The contract type printed in the notice is Executive – Fixed Term Contract.

faq.question: Q9. Are handwritten applications accepted?
faq.answer: No. The notice says handwritten applications will not be accepted; the form must be filled in digitally and saved as a PDF or Word file.

faq.question: Q10. Who must provide a No Objection Certificate?
faq.answer: Candidates working in Government, Semi-Government Organizations, Public Sector Undertakings or Autonomous Bodies must provide an NOC at the time of the interview.
